notes.title: NEW Catto Pew Pew! Steam Page is LIVE
notes.content: [h2]Hi everyone![/h2][p]After almost three years of development, I'm excited to tell you that the Steam page for the [i]brand-new[/i] [i][b]Catto Pew Pew![/b] [/i]just went live. This is the ULTIMATE version of Catto Pew Pew!, featuring VR/PC crossplay, new gamemodes, power-ups, ranks, and tons more. [u]Add it to your wishlist to get notified when it's released![/u] [/p][p][/p][h3][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3665520/Catto_Pew_Pew/"][/dynamiclink][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]QUESTION:[/b] [i]"Can I still play the original game?"[/i][/h3][p]Yes! The original [i]Catto Pew Pew! CLASSIC[/i] version will continue to be available for whenever you start feeling a little nostalgic.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]QUESTION:[/b] [i]"What about my DLC on Catto Pew Pew! CLASSIC?"[/i][/h3][p]While the new game features a completely different monetization and cosmetic system, there will be a way for you to be rewarded with some awesome in-game goodies as a thank-you for supporting the original game.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Thank you for all the amazing support over the years. I can't wait to share this new game with you guys :) [/h3][h2][i]- Oakley[/i][/h2]

tags.feature: This is the ULTIMATE version of Catto Pew Pew!, featuring VR/PC crossplay, new gamemodes, power-ups, ranks, and tons more.

notes.title: SEQUEL COMING OUT SOON!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42744725/3cec12e558991c7244584ca0ddc87b3ef1ea06d6.png[/img]
[h1][b]Hi There! A sequel to this game has been in the works for two years, and it's coming out soon[/b][/h1]


It takes everything that makes this game so fun and improves on it in huge ways. Here's a list of new features:

[i]- All bugs and player complaints from this version are completely fixed (yes, the weird sliding problem is gone!)
- VR/PC Crossplay, with mobile planned
- Free for All, King of the Hill, and Race game modes
- Tons of cosmetics
- A full soundtrack with music for every map
- Powerups
- Earn trophies for winning matches
- A Catto Pew Pew! Account system to save your progress across all platforms
- And much more![/i]

More info coming soon. Thank you for playing my game! - Oakley Blade

notes.title: Christmas Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42744725/57ded7f467aedd3f558a60983dee1ff438588876.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=M7jcHVd42MA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Update 2.0: Christmas Update![/h1]

This Update has been in the works for a while, 
and now I can finally present it to you!

[h2]CAPTURE THE FLAG:[/h2]
Classic Capture the Flag - 2 teams, 2 flags, capture the required flags to win!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42744725/5f3f4dcb09f2ce580f2035ef106a4922200ab8ed.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42744725/1af61cb1bf80e83ee6de859faf0815c1edbe94fc.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42744725/1564442d864b5b34f4d6b171a1821b59c6274993.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42744725/d4956fa0409676415949a19dbf216f6d15f1233c.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42744725/92e334eafbabaec7c87aa6c4aa3428d125d873bb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42744725/50d06c1afca9e56b6d7060c75b92aa54aebadeca.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42744725/8194eec9d2048d1a58c4f4e2f7e8bd9083ec6fe6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42744725/f19bb5743e7c0ea7da23664765cc89ab877871a7.png[/img][/url]

As of now, the map Sky Isle is free while the other three maps are available
with the Coolest Catto DLC.


[h2]HATTO'S FOR CHARITY DLC:[/h2]
6 new festive hats, available for purchase on 12/21/2022.
All net proceeds from the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2236210/Catto_Pew_Pew__Hattos_for_Charity_Cosmetic_Pack/]Hatto's For Charity DLC[/url] will go to the Sloan Memorial
Kettering Cancer Center.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42744725/6e623a02868fe8c81168b170cf35d669738a34f7.png[/img]

Have a Merry Christmas, God Bless!

Mr. Patchnotes loves the Christmas season, it makes him very happy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42744725/a8a6dbe807427b5ca7719abcddaf2c8b2c6dccbd.gif[/img]

notes.title: New Gamemodes!
notes.content:
This update comes with 2 new gamemodes, TIMED and SCRAMBLE!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42744725/a11dd81e1c0a5970f5c272c965aa7b44945ec0fc.png[/img]
I have been working with a guy (Thanks EvolvedPheonix) 
to get gamemodes into the game, and here is the result! 

Side Note: TIMED and SCRAMBLE gamemodes are best played with friends.
Side Note 2: The more specialized gamemodes will more than likely eventually put in the DLC in the future. For now though, they are free for everyone.

Next in the list:
 - Keybinds
 - 1 other community map (sorry for the long wait 07Moon, I promise i'll get to it!)
 - New Gamemodes

Coming eventually when I have enough time 
to just sit down and set it up:
- Map specific music and more SFX
- Improvements to the map editor

Updates might slow down a tad soon here, school is about to get tough again.
I'll still be working on the game a lot though.

Mr. Patchnotes says that the new gamemodes are very cool and epic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42744725/a8a6dbe807427b5ca7719abcddaf2c8b2c6dccbd.gif[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.06 - Private Room System :D
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42744725/0bf8a55e354a22fb8fa56666c14bcb8136724b6a.png[/img]

This patch comes with some slight map changes and a new system for starting private matches.

I noticed people were having trouble trying to play only with friends, so I created a new system for private lobbies. Just make a private room, give your friends the room name, and viola!

Next on the list:
 - Keybinds
 - A truckload of cosmetics
 - 2 really cool community maps

Coming eventually when I have enough time 
to just sit down and set it up:
 - Gamemodes
 - Map specific music and more SFX
 - Improvements to the map editor

I just started school, and day one the ventilation is out. Gonna be a fun year :')

Mr. Patchnotes fits in pretty well, dontcha' think? He's a very good boy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42744725/a8a6dbe807427b5ca7719abcddaf2c8b2c6dccbd.gif[/img]

notes.content:
[h1]MAY THE CHEATERS PERISH, AHAHAHAHAH[/h1]

Some cheating has been going on in the game recently, so I have given the match host the option to kick players. I also changed some maps to have fewer OP camping areas. I also patched out a few minor bugs as well.

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42744725/a8a6dbe807427b5ca7719abcddaf2c8b2c6dccbd.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42744725/a8a6dbe807427b5ca7719abcddaf2c8b2c6dccbd.gif[/img][/url]

This is a day 1 patch to the game and is just a band-aid fix to some
issues that came up. 

The bug involving silent voice chat is being looked into, and 
there is a makeshift tutorial in the room menu. An exploit involving
usernames has been fixed. Host bans are coming soon.

On another note: It's only day 1 of release, 
and already the server browser is filling up and people are sharing
the game. Getting to see the incredible reactions from people
in-game has made my day. Thanks, Y'all.

tags.bug: An exploit involving usernames has been fixed.
